hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians attempting to cross from the view of oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures are conducive to higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Travel lanes in the center and left of the frame.

hazards.name: High-speed multi-lane roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the roadway.

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of vertical elements like trees or curb extensions encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility box with advertising occupies a significant portion of the sidewalk, narrowing the path and potentially blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the sidewalk

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a center turn lane/median and bike lanes, which would slow traffic and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe point for pedestrians to cross the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees and a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the high-speed travel lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a vertical buffer between the walkway and the roadway, enhancing safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for a protected bike lane to narrow travel lanes and provide an additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: If the block is long, a mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island would improve connectivity and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a row of street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the high-speed traffic lanes.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Reallocate a portion of the wide roadway to include protected bicycle infrastructure, which also acts as a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Paint clear crosswalk markings across the driveway entrance to define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Bollards or Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bollards at the edges of the driveway to prevent vehicle encroachment on the sidewalk and narrow the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the driveway entrance to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Install a line of trees or large planters to create a protective buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk at Driveway
interventions.description: Elevate the sidewalk across the driveway entrance to prioritize pedestrians and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also improving the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a legal and safer crossing point for pedestrians between intersections.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Enhancement
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing median into a formal pedestrian refuge island with cut-throughs and protective bollards.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and potentially a pedestrian-actuated signal if demand warrants.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at regular intervals to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Modify the existing median to include protected refuge areas with curb ramps at crossing points, allowing pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross this wide multi-lane street.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees along the curb would provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Marked Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings across the parking lot entrance to clearly define pedestrian priority and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance using curb extensions or bollards to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Utility Box Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the large utility box to the edge of the sidewalk or a furniture zone to clear the primary walking path.
